A cassette with no case and no printed anything, the shell a scavenged one with the old label scraped off in a hurry, so a shred of somebody else's title is still stuck under the corner. It has been copied from a copy from a copy and it looks it.

  ┌───────────────────────────────┐
  │        F O R M   9            │
  │ ──────────────────────────────│
  │  COPY THIS TAPE · 11 MIN      │
  │  ( )    ( )   GEN 4 OR WORSE  │
  │ ═══════════════════════════   │
  └───────────────────────────────┘

Written across the top in ballpoint, biting into the plastic: "RUN OFF AS MANY AS YOU LIKE. DO NOT PAY FOR IT AND DO NOT CHARGE FOR IT."
